document.title: Phase 1: Torture slice
document.p: Goal (PLAN.md): a minimal XML parser and XPath 4.0 subset exercising all of the value model, native and WebAssembly, passing the 198 tests of tests/qt4/torture-slice.txt under sanitizers; then the substrate freezes. Packets of one agent session each run in parallel in one working tree; each names the files it owns, and concurrent packets never share one. Design packets may change headers; implementation packets must not (they write the need under "Proposed" in docs/DECISIONS.md). Until the gate, substrate headers change only through a decision record.

item.p: Registration is by glob. After , src/*.c is the library, each tests/<name>_test.c is ctest test <name>, and tests/qt4/driver, tests/fuzz, third_party/mpdecimal join when their CMakeLists.txt exists. Packets add files, never lines to a shared list.
Module prefixes own files, src/ stays flat: src/<module>.c, src/<module>_<part>.c, src/<module>_internal.h, tests/<module>*_test.c.

Ledgers are shared (docs/DECISIONS.md, GLOSSARY.md, LOG.md): one small insertion, committed at once and alone; re-read before claiming a D-number. Glossary terms come before code. Root CMakeLists.txt, CMakePresets.json, ci.yml: only the owning packet edits them. apps/ and docs/CLI.md belong to the CLI ().

Every packet imitates src/memory.c and tests/memory_test.c (lifecycle, allocation-failure loops, ) unless it names another golden file; checks leaks with sxml_item_heap_read_counts where values are made; cites the specification in comments; is done when debug, debug-gcc and wasm pass, tools/lint.sh is clean and the slice count (after ) has not dropped.

section.p: A packet starts once those after "After" are committed. Critical path: 1.0 1.1 1.6 1.7 1.11 1.13 1.18 1.20 1.23 1.25 1.27 1.29. The CLI (not a packet) adds sxml check after and sxml xpath after .
